name: Hörden am Harz (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Hörden am Harz (a yellow anchor-like house mark on blue).
history: The Oberkreisdirektor of the then Landkreis Osterode am Harz granted the municipality permission to bear arms, a seal and a flag by order of 15 May 1979; the flag is yellow-blue striped with the arms shifted towards the hoist.

features.role: Hörden am Harz arms — house mark on blue
